answer:
**Natural-language hypothesis (main answer).** In the supplied meta-regression dataset, **17 of 18 original studies in the Experimental Economics (project=='ee') replication project were conducted in a lab setting**, i.e. an estimated proportion of **17/18 ≈ 94.4%** (sensitivity range 61.1%–100% across alternative proxies; the strict "US-lab" sub-proxy gives only 11/18 ≈ 61.1%, which undercounts non-US university labs and should not be used as the headline). The single non-lab case is **ee.4 "Participation"**, which used a **community** subject sample in the United States — the only EE study with `subjects.o='community'`; all 17 of the remaining EE studies used **student subject pools, were conducted offline, and paid cash compensation**, which together strongly indicate in-person laboratory experiments.

This answer uses the wide replication-study table (the only file in the dataset that exposes the `subjects.o` / `online.o` / `us_lab.o` / `experiment_country.o` fields needed to identify lab vs. non-lab settings); the second aggregated table (143 × 15) carries only effect-size summaries for the same 18 EE studies and was not used in the numerator/denominator calculation.

payload.hypothesis: In the Experimental Economics (project=='ee') slice of the supplied meta-regression dataset, 17 of 18 original studies (≈94.4%) were conducted in a lab setting under the conventional proxy (subjects.o == 'students' AND online.o == 0). The lone exception is ee.4 'Participation', which used a community subject sample.
payload.workflow: 1. Loaded the wide table (927×57) and aggregated table (143×15) from data/. 2. Subset project=='ee' (18 rows; id-unique within EE; no overlap with other projects). 3. Filtered the denominator: id-deduped, effect_size.o non-missing, drop==False. All 18 EE rows satisfy both filters, so N=18. 4. Defined proxy A = (subjects.o=='students') AND (online.o==0); counted numerator k=17. 5. Reported sensitivity proxies B (offline only: 18/18), C (us_lab.o==1: 11/18), D (A ∧ us_lab.o==1: 10/18), and the anti-lab counter-example E (subjects.o=='community': 1). 6. Cross-tabbed experiment_country.o × us_lab.o to show that the 7 us_lab.o==0 EE studies are all non-US university labs (DE×2, CH×2, UK×1, AU×1, AT×1) with subjects.o=students + online.o=0 + compensation.o=cash, justifying why proxy C under-counts. 7. Cross-checked with the aggregated table: 18 EE rows in both files; aggregated file has no lab-identifying fields and is therefore not used in the calculation. 8. Saved artifacts/analysis_main.py (executable script) and artifacts/ee_lab_breakdown.csv (per-EE-study breakdown with all proxy flags).
